note: Trick-1 silver set, mechanism test (docs/m3-hybrid/silver.md; owner, 2026-10-17): 16 trick-1 decisions of the full set's generator (search decisions --trick 1 --count 400 --seed 1; two a seat position, ids 33/66 at seat 1 up to 61/94 at seat 8) x 8 worlds, each world valued by H_3 (exact search through tricks 1 and 2, the adopted O_3 f5766aa9 at the start of trick 3) into silver-t1-c3-n8.jsonl, resumable world by world; the decisions and the silver worlds shared content-addressed; agree and curves on them; then search hybrid-check of a toy O_2 (round 1 of m3-hybrid-t2-mech-6, 1024-512-128, 25,000 labels: only to run the step) against them with --reference silver, 3% of the silver worlds recomputed and required byte-identical, the score and race groups. Every step runs once; the timing file (silver-t1-c3-n8.jsonl.times.jsonl) gives H_3's thread-seconds, nodes and network evaluations per seat on the real machine, to confirm the price of the full set before it is launched. The 2 leader decisions' 16 worlds may hold one of the rare worlds whose H_3 takes an hour or more on one thread: it sets the wall time.
